info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Branch Location Management API
info.description: The Branch Location Management API facilitates the update of branch location details within the banking channel. This endpoint allows users to modify existing branch information, ensuring accurate and current data management. It is primarily utilized by bank administrators and system integrators to keep branch records aligned with operational changes or compliance requirements. Typical use cases include updating branch addresses, operating hours, and contact information.

patch.summary: Update a specific branch location management resource.
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update information related to a specific branch location management resource identified by RES-100045. Utilize this operation to modify the attributes of the branch location as necessary to ensure the most accurate and up-to-date data.

requestBody.description: Updates the information related to a specific branch location within the channel. This includes modifications to location details, operational hours, and any relevant attributes governing the branch's functionality.
